title: An evidence manifest document
description: One evidence package's top-level binder (SEG-SREQ-035): the scope it was generated for and whether that scope is total (SEG-SREQ-038, SEG-SREQ-039), the current revision it was assembled against, and relative references to the three sibling documents it anchors. Carries no repository SHAs beyond the one this single-repository layout has (ADR-0002/ADR-0004), where a multi-repository layout would anchor one per repository.

requestedScope.description: The requirement identifiers the scope was requested for, sorted.

memberScope.description: Every identifier the scope's expansion collected, sorted — a superset of requestedScope.

total.description: Whether memberScope includes every top-level requirement in the graph the scope was collected from (SEG-SREQ-039).

revision.description: The current revision of the implementation repository this package was assembled against — the one source revision a single-repository binding has.

designConsistencyProof.description: The design consistency proof document's file name, relative to this manifest's own directory.

executionCoverageRecord.description: The execution coverage record document's file name, relative to this manifest's own directory.

coverageReport.description: The coverage report document's file name, relative to this manifest's own directory.

runBundles.description: The digest of every run bundle that supplied a test outcome in the package's scope, sorted. Optional, so that a package written before run bundles were recorded still reads.
